title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
goal: Solve Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array: Binary search: if mid > right the minimum is in the right half, otherwise in the left.
strategy: Binary search: if mid > right the minimum is in the right half, otherwise in the left.
edgeCases: The array may already be sorted; comparing against the right boundary still retains the minimum.
inputRules: Must be JSON array of integers
